$comment: Single source of truth for how every exam on this platform is scored and assembled.
SCHEME follows the new NEC pattern given by the project owner: 100 questions x 1 mark,
120 minutes, pass 50, no negative marking. The older publicly-documented pattern
(60 x 1 mark + 20 x 2 marks = 100 marks) is kept in `alternateSchemes` so the engine can
run either without a code change - set `activeScheme` to switch.
WEIGHTAGE: NEC's stated principle is 'one question per subchapter' across 60 subchapters.
Scaled to a 100-question paper that is 10 questions per chapter (every chapter has exactly
6 subchapters). This uniform baseline is marked `provisional`. It is to be replaced by
`empirical` counts once all 15 real past papers are transcribed - see tools/derive-weightage.mjs.
Model-set generation reads whichever profile `activeWeightage` names.

provisional-uniform.label: Provisional — uniform, from NEC's one-question-per-subchapter rule
